title: Zoning compatibility review
description: A planning checkpoint to discuss whether the proposed use fits the property.
plain_language_explanation: Share the project location and intended use with zoning staff before later applications.
why_required: Selected by a demonstration project-category rule.
questions_for_department: Does this address require any special zoning review?

title: Food establishment health review
description: A demonstration review of food preparation practices and facilities.
plain_language_explanation: Prepare a menu, food-safety materials, and a basic operating plan for discussion with health staff.
why_required: Food preparation was selected in intake.
questions_for_department: Which state and local food rules apply to this project?

title: Fire-safety review
description: A demonstration safety review for occupancy, cooking, or public events.
plain_language_explanation: Ask fire-prevention staff whether plans or an inspection are needed.
why_required: The project includes activity that may need safety confirmation.
questions_for_department: Is a fire inspection or occupancy check needed?

title: Local business registration
plain_language_explanation: Confirm the business registration steps after prerequisite reviews are complete.
why_required: A business project type was selected.
questions_for_department: What registrations apply to this business structure?

title: Building plan review
description: A demonstration technical review of construction drawings.
plain_language_explanation: Submit drawings after zoning confirms the project may proceed.
questions_for_department: What drawing set and professional stamps are required?

title: Final inspection
plain_language_explanation: Schedule a final inspection only after plan review and project work are complete.
why_required: Construction work needs a close-out checkpoint in this demo workflow.
questions_for_department: Which inspections must occur before final approval?

title: Temporary event application
description: A demonstration intake step for a temporary public event.
plain_language_explanation: Share the event date, location, attendance, and layout with the clerk.
why_required: A public event project was selected.
questions_for_department: How far ahead should the event application be submitted?

title: Public space and access review
description: A demonstration review for street, sidewalk, or public-space impacts.
plain_language_explanation: Confirm access, waste, parking, and public-space plans.
why_required: Public attendance was selected for a temporary event.
questions_for_department: Will the event affect a street, sidewalk, or public facility?

title: Event coordination complete
plain_language_explanation: Return to the clerk after participating departments finish review.
why_required: This is the final dependency checkpoint for the demo event workflow.
questions_for_department: What must be complete before event confirmation?
